newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX ACCESS trade passes 3 million contract level.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX ACCESS trade passes 3 million contract level.

text.p: Trading on the NYMEX ACCESS electronic trading system passed the 3 million contract mark Tuesday evening when a total of 7,928 contracts were traded, bringing the overall tally to 3,001,113 contracts, NYMEX said.

Daily volume has grown steadily on the system, with an average of 5,000 contracts traded each night. Crude futures are the most actively traded contract with an average daily volume of 2,200 contracts, NYMEX said.
NYMEX President R. Patrick Thompson said increased volume was a result of growing interest from Asia Pacific participants since a link with the Sydney Futures Exchange SYCOM system was established.
Thompson said he looked forward to further growth in Asia when terminals open in Hong Kong during the first quarter of 1997.
